name: FieldSkeleton
description:
The loading shape of a Field: a label-role text line, a block of the control's exact
height and the reserved message line — the same boxes as the loaded field (R9.3).
signature: ({ control, size, rows, labelWidth, orientation, className, ...rest }: FieldSkeletonProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: control
props.description: The control the field holds; the placeholder takes exactly its box.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Direction of layout and keyboard navigation.

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
